name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions in Cindy. When you open a PR, an interactive card helps you submit it and automatically follows CI and reviews until merge. Uses the local GitHub login. Supports github.com.
whenToUse: Use for github.com repositories and links; use GitLab for GitLab instances. Handles issues, PRs, reviews, merges, repositories, Actions, releases, search, and logs. Use the PR card to ask about opening a PR and to show its status afterwards. Uses the local GitHub login or a fallback token.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 117 GitHub operations across issues, pulls, repo, commits, actions, releases, search, users, orgs, events, notifications, gists, git_data, reactions, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitHub operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Repository operations require explicit owner and repo values, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin when working in a repository. API-link fields are removed by default except html_url; set raw=true for the original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Downloads such as Actions artifacts or log ZIPs require a destination directory in the top-level save_dir field of ghost_call.

pr_card.description: Show a PR card in Cindy (not IM). To ask about opening a PR, pass repo, head, base and optional commits/files. The agent commits and opens it only after a click or explicit request. Update the same card with card_id and pr after opening, and apply its todo; renamed/following report completed actions only. Viewing an existing PR never starts following. Before starting, pass claim_follow=true and require success with follow_claimed=true before creating a schedule. If another task is following, existing_task returns a status-only card explaining why, with a task entry: supporting clients navigate directly; older clients request a reply link on click. open-task is navigation only. Delete and verify the schedule before reporting following=false; the user can then follow in another task. Refresh with card_id each background round; use to_latest when notifying the user. follow_workflow gives bundled Skill/checker reading locations and recovery from missing Manuals; do not write replacement scripts.

pr_follow_settings.description: Read the same auto-rename, auto-follow and follow-model preferences used by PR cards. Returns settings without showing a card, creating a task or starting follow-up; preferences are not proof that following is active. Use after opening a PR in IM too, then create and verify follow-up with the pr workflow. A read failure means unknown, not disabled. follow_workflow gives bundled Skill/checker reading locations and recovery from missing Manuals; do not write replacement scripts.
